_nota: Fundo das peças de divulgação (enredo v6). A arte NÃO tem texto: logo (media/logo/logo-final.png) e slogan entram por cima em tools/divulgacao.mjs, com as fontes do site. Cada formato é gerado à parte (e não recortado de um só) para a composição respirar: céu escuro e vazio no terço de cima, onde a logo pousa. Gerar com: node tools/gen_art.mjs --manifest tools/divulgacao_art_manifest.json --out divulgacao/_arte
styleSuffix: Cinematic AAA video game key art for a slow, tactical survival extraction game about a meteorite that brought an alien FUNGUS to Earth. Infected people are living humans overtaken by pale grey mycelium and shelf-fungus, faint sickly lime-green bioluminescence, unsettling but NOT gory. Overcast dusk, volumetric fog, muted olive greens, ash greys and cold blacks with lime-green accents, dramatic rim light, photorealistic, extremely detailed. The upper third of the frame is calm dark stormy sky with NO important detail, reserved for a title logo. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no UI, single continuous scene, no border, no frame, not a diptych.

jobs.prompt: Modern advertising key art poster composition, epic and clean like a AAA game launch banner. HERO: one tactical soldier in dark olive gear, helmet and gas mask hanging on the chest, rifle held low and ready, standing firm in the RIGHT-CENTER foreground, lit by a strong lime-green rim light from behind, determined, facing three-quarters toward the camera. AROUND AND BEHIND HIM, arranged in depth like a cast lineup and clearly readable as separate figures: towering in the hazy background behind him the AMÁLGAMA, a four-meter mass of several infected human bodies fused together by thick grey mycelium; to his left a FEBRIL infected man sprinting toward him with hot breath steaming; on a broken rooftop above a VIGIA infected crouched with antenna-like fungal stalks growing from its skull; near his feet a LOBO-CINZA infected grey wolf snarling with fungus on its spine; a bloated SEMEADOR infected with yellow spore sacs in the mid-ground haze; a flock of infected crows (REVOADA) circling in the sky; clusters of glowing lime-green mushrooms (FAROL) on the ground. Setting: ruined industrial zone at night with a green glowing meteor crater far behind, falling ash and spores, volumetric light beams. The LEFT 40% of the frame is darker and calmer (fog and sky, few details) to hold a title logo and slogan

Seen from behind, a squad of four tactical operators in dark olive gear crouched on a rocky forested ridge in the lower foreground, one pointing, one with binoculars, looking down at a ruined coastal industrial town in a valley; at the center of the town a deep impact crater glows faintly lime-green, the half-buried black porous meteorite core visible, grey mycelium spreading out over roofs and roads like frost; small infected silhouettes wander the streets far below; clusters of glowing green mushrooms on the pine trunks near the squad; a faint old scar of smoke across the sky where the meteor came in; pine forest and mountains framing the valley
